title: Current PoC, proposed flagship and future R&D
text: This maturity map is intentionally conservative. The accessible project sources document a compact, phone/controlled-imaging AST concept and a much broader aspirational architecture, but they do not constitute evidence that the flagship has been integrated or clinically validated [S1-S5].
tables: Domain
Current PoC / documented baseline
Proposed APEX XR
Future / advanced R&D
Imaging
Compact or phone-assisted plate capture; controlled lighting concept
31 MP whole-plate metrology path plus separate RGB/NIR research path
Adaptive multispectral imaging and learned acquisition policies
AST
AI-assisted disk/zone workflow under development
Calibrated disk-diffusion measurement, QC, standards rules and human sign-off
Validated early-growth/RAST configurations and predictive decision support
MIC
Not evidenced as direct quantitative hardware
Automated broth microdilution imaging and concentration-map execution
Assay expansion and kinetic MIC models; zone-to-MIC prediction remains research only
Incubation
Controlled enclosure / smart-incubation concept
Programmable temperature, humidity and gas environment with independent safety
Adaptive experiment control and closed-loop biological optimization
Sensing

BME690 array, gravimetric QC, coarse ToF positioning
Validated sensor-fusion biomarkers and mechanistic models
3D
VL53L8CX concept
Coarse positioning with VL53L8CX; dedicated profilometer for research morphology
Validated 3D phenotype classifiers
Automation

24-48 plate queue, barcode tracking and constrained liquid handling

Plate capture, analysis and report concept
Four-layer stack, PIMS/digital twin, BAHU, local rules engine and integrations

Clinical status
Prototype / research development
Intended clinical configuration after validation and formal regulatory determination
Expanded claims only after new evidence and approvals

EVIDENCE RULE
A feature appearing in a proposal is a design input, not proof of implementation. The development team should maintain a capability-evidence matrix linking each claim to a test report, dataset, risk control and approval state.
